limits: 4/4 applies only to final single-robot CV straight-reference finite-scene tests, not universal safety/reliability
Seeds 211/239 are viewed development seeds, not unseen statistical validation
Motion acceptance window [4,39] was frozen before this stage; startup/end transients preserved in raw records
No positive lower speed bound added to original optimizer; emergency stop retained
8-second held-axis preview is a decision approximation, only original N=10 hard prefix rechecked
Some angular velocity spikes and an early oblique-side update remain; no global smoothness/optimality guarantee
Tradeoffs include larger lateral excursion and slightly higher overtake RMSE/cost than the paired baseline
No five-robot/physical deployment; Gazebo odom remains world-source
All failed/development runs retained; raw data and papers not uploaded
